# Aenuka Buddhakorala

> Official portfolio of Aenuka Buddhakorala, a software engineering undergraduate and developer in Colombo, Sri Lanka.

Aenuka builds accessible product interfaces, maintainable backend services, and distributed systems. His core technologies include React, JavaScript, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, SQL, MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, and Cypress.
